authority: The owner's Axiom Portfolio master prompts. Purpose and acceptance text is VERBATIM from those documents - never rewrite it downward to make a run look finished. See memory/doctrine/PROVENANCE.md.
governing_sentence: The goal is not to make every program resemble the same generic application. The goal is to make every program successfully perform the particular job it was created to perform.

ai-time.name: AI Time
ai-time.locator: Baseline local source from the supplied shortcut: C:\Users\firer\AITime; launcher AI Time.vbs through wscript.exe.
ai-time.purpose: accurately show Dr. White when usage credits or quotas reset and how many credits, requests, tokens, or time-window allowances remain across every AI provider, account, model, CLI, desktop application, and local AI endpoint actually available on the machine.
acceptance_criteria: accurate live reconciliation for every available provider that exposes usage
truthful unavailable for providers that do not
required_design: dynamically discover providers rather than hardcoding only a few
separate provider, account, plan, model, quota type, and reset window
show limit, used, remaining, reset timestamp, countdown, local time, UTC, source, last refresh, freshness, and confidence
use official usage/quota APIs, official CLIs, or authenticated official dashboards where permitted
never invent values when a provider does not expose exact quota
label exact, provider-reported, locally calculated, estimated, stale, unavailable, and unlimited-local states distinctly
treat local Ollama models as no provider-credit limit while showing hardware/resource limits separately
handle multiple rolling windows, monthly limits, daily limits, model-specific caps, and plan changes
store secrets in OS-protected storage or environment configuration; never log tokens or passwords
handle clock skew, daylight saving changes, provider timezone differences, offline mode, session expiry, 2FA handoff, and selector/API changes
provide a readable dashboard and tray/desktop status without popup storms
